notes: Seed list (Märklin, Roco, Fleischmann, Kato, Tillig, Piko, Rivarossi). Scale and gauge standards are separate. A German H0 maker directory returned 403.

notes: Arranged by material, so makers repeat. Sibling pages list model car and aircraft makers. Cross-check against Scalemates.

notes: Includes diecast, resin, slot-car and tinplate brands from many countries. Marked incomplete by Wikipedia.

notes: Starting list for toy makers outside the model and figure channels. Companies only; products are on each page.

organised_by: type (electronic, office, sound, spinning, wooden, games)

approx_entries: unknown (membership and certified-product lists not seen)

notes: Official table-tennis approvals by brand and product. Anchor for table-tennis rubbers and balls. Blades are not covered.

notes: PDF list by implement and weight. Companion lists cover track and jumping equipment. Dated lists change; harvest the newest one.

Iron sets by brand and decade with loft. Useful for model-name lists; coverage is iron sets only.

World Federation of the Sporting Goods Industry. Mixed members: brands, suppliers, service firms. Short on volume but shows the leading makers.

notes: Example of a maker line catalogue that spans several sports. The US store lists 244 badminton and 100 tennis products.

notes: Sport-by-sport maker lists. Also a main list page of sporting goods manufacturers. Individual pages may be uneven in quality.

Anchor for Eurorack, pedal and 500-series makers and models. Vendor list holds many small makers. Includes DIY and unknown-maker entries.
Reference pages per synth, drum machine and sampler, by maker. Popular models listed on the home page. Complements Reverb for keyboards.
Models with manufacturer-published data in common units. Covers vintage and current mics; one niche, but dense.

organised_by: instrument family: wind, string, percussion, electronic, unclassified
notes: Descriptions with alternate names, including Japanese, Chinese and Indian instruments. Good alias source for the kind level. Community edited.

notes: Anchor for violin-family makers and provenance. Most data needs a subscription; maker lists and cities are open. Luthier makers are artisans.

notes: Gives factory-to-brand links (FujiGen, Dyna Gakki, Matsumoku, Kasuga). Directly supports the built_by_maker field for designer and builder.

organised_by: marque, company, country, market, product types
notes: Gives company-to-marque links and whether the maker offers handguns, shotguns or rifles. Dynamic list, not complete.

notes: Includes non-firearm defence makers; filter to small arms and ammunition. Good coverage of state arsenals (Fabricaciones Militares, FAMAE, Zastava).

organised_by: alphabetical; also lists by type, action, country
notes: Hub for list pages by type (assault rifles, semi-automatic shotguns) and country. Entries give country, year and cartridge.

Brands with model counts (Hatsan 417, FX 326, Benjamin and Crosman 317). Young community site; check models against maker pages.
